description: This file defines the AuthorizationControl class which manages authorization rules and approval workflows for transactions within ERPNext, including methods to validate rules, determine approvers, and enforce approval based on total amounts and roles.

classes.name: AuthorizationControl
classes.description: A class responsible for managing authorization rules, approval hierarchies, and validation logic for various transactions in ERPNext.

methods.name: get_appr_user_role(self, det, doctype_name, total, based_on, condition, item, company)
methods.description: Determines the approving users and roles based on maximum amounts and authorization rules.

methods.name: validate_auth_rule(self, doctype_name, total, based_on, cond, company, item = '')
methods.description: Validates if approval is required based on specified rules, total amount, and items involved.

methods.name: bifurcate_based_on_type(self, doctype_name, total, av_dis, based_on, doc_obj, val, company)
methods.description: Executes approval bifurcation logic based on different approval types such as user, role, or global.

methods.name: validate_approving_authority(self, doctype_name,company, total, doc_obj = '')
methods.description: Main method to validate if the current user has the authority to approve a transaction based on multiple criteria.

methods.name: get_value_based_rule(self,doctype_name,employee,total_claimed_amount,company)
methods.description: Retrieves the applicable authorization rule based on the employee and total claimed amount.

methods.name: get_approver_name(self, doctype_name, total, doc_obj='')
methods.description: Fetches the list of approvers for a given document, based on various authorization rules.

ctags.name: bifurcate_based_on_type
ctags.pattern: /^	def bifurcate_based_on_type(self, doctype_name, total, av_dis, based_on, doc_obj, val, company)/
ctags.signature: (self, doctype_name, total, av_dis, based_on, doc_obj, val, company)

ctags.name: get_appr_user_role
ctags.pattern: /^	def get_appr_user_role(self, det, doctype_name, total, based_on, condition, item, company):$/
ctags.signature: (self, det, doctype_name, total, based_on, condition, item, company)

ctags.name: validate_auth_rule
ctags.pattern: /^	def validate_auth_rule(self, doctype_name, total, based_on, cond, company, item = ''):$/
ctags.signature: (self, doctype_name, total, based_on, cond, company, item = '')
